items.titulo: Sarvam Launches Sarvam Token Factory: Bringing India-Hosted Inference to 8 Open Models
items.resumen: Sarvam Token Factory is now open to everyone. It serves Sarvam 105B, GLM 5.3, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Kimi K3.1 Pro and Gemma 4 31B from GPU clusters in India through one OpenAI-compatible API. Release: llm 0.37.3 A bug fix release for LLM , mainly to cover a problem with the most recent Homebrew package of the software. Homebrew now ships the latest SQLite, 3.54.1 , which includes a fix that broke LLM's logging code . Short version: in SQLite 3.54.0 the following SQL: select json_object('a', (select json_array(1))) Returns this: {"a":[1]} But in 3.54.1 the same query returns this: {"a":"[1]"} According to D. items.titulo: Liquid AI Releases d1.2 and d1.2-ultra: Omnimodal Decision Models That Top the AA Decision Index
items.resumen: Liquid AI released d1.2 and d1.2-ultra, decision models that read text, images and audio and return calibrated probabilities with zero output tokens. d1.2-ultra scores 75 on the Artificial Analysis Decision Index v2.1. items.titulo: NVIDIA Open-Sources NVKE and NVKR for Managed Kubernetes on GPU Infrastructure
items.resumen: NVIDIA has open-sourced NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine (NVKE) and NVIDIA Kubernetes Recipes (NVKR) under Apache 2.0. Together they let AI factories run a managed Kubernetes service on their own bare-metal GPU servers. Both are in public preview. The post NVIDIA Open-Sources NVKE and NVKR for Managed Kubernetes on GPU Infrastructure appeared first on MarkTechPost .
